name: BoardKeep
tagline: The operating system for community association managers.
positioning: BoardKeep consolidates dues, violations, board packets, and reserves into one ledger built for firms managing dozens of associations at once.

hero.h1: Run every association from one ledger.
hero.sub: BoardKeep replaces the spreadsheet-and-email chaos of managing multiple HOAs — assessments, violations, ARC requests, and board packets in a single system of record.

features.title: Assessment Ledger
features.description: Bill dues and special assessments across every association, auto-post payments, and generate delinquency reports your board actually trusts.

features.title: Violation Tracking
features.description: Log covenant violations with photos, fire escalation notices on schedule, and keep a defensible audit trail for every parcel.

features.title: Board Packet Builder
features.description: Compile agendas, financials, and ARC decisions into a board-ready packet in minutes instead of the night before the meeting.

features.title: Reserve Planning
features.description: Model reserve funding against your study, flag underfunded components, and export the schedule your CPA and board expect.

features.title: Homeowner Portal
features.description: Give residents a branded portal to pay dues, submit ARC requests, and check violation status — cutting inbound calls to your office.

features.title: Compliance Calendar
features.description: Track statutory deadlines, annual meetings, and disclosure filings per association so nothing slips through the cracks.

testimonials.quote: We manage 41 associations with a team of six. BoardKeep cut our month-end close from eleven days to three and killed the spreadsheet handoffs entirely.
testimonials.name: Dana Okafor

testimonials.quote: Board packets used to eat an entire evening per association. Now our managers assemble them in twenty minutes and the boards stopped asking where the numbers came from.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elwell

testimonials.quote: The violation audit trail alone paid for the seats. When a homeowner disputed a fine, we pulled the full timeline with photos in seconds.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

homepage.footerBlurb: BoardKeep is the system of record for community association management firms. Built for managers, boards, and the ledgers they answer to.
